Discover the inspiring MDH success story of Mahashay Dharampal Gulati, who started with just ₹1,500 and built the iconic MDH Masala brand. This business case study explores MDH history, its business model, marketing strategy, and the journey of its owner.
Learn how Dharampal Gulati overcame the challenges of Partition and built a successful Indian business through simple ideas, strong distribution, and customer trust.
Watch Abhi and Niyu for more Indian business stories, entrepreneur success stories, and business case studies.
A video by Abhiraj Rajadhyaksha & Niyati Mavinkurve
